company.name: RunKit
company.shortDescription: RunKit notebooks are interactive playgrounds connected to a complete node environment right in your browser.
company.description:
RunKit is the best tool for prototyping server-side JavaScript.

RunKit notebooks remove the friction of trying new ideas. With one click, you'll have a sandboxed JavaScript environment where you can instantly switch node versions, use every npm module without having to wait to install it, and even visualize your results.

productsAndServices.description: An interactive, browser-based JavaScript environment for prototyping and exploring Node.js code with instant access to all npm packages and multiple Node versions.
productsAndServices.name: RunKit Notebooks

productsAndServices.description: A serverless API service that lets users create HTTP endpoints by exporting a function in a RunKit notebook, without managing servers or deployments.
